decisions.reason: It has stayed prominently marketed since 2023 and fits closely with the firm's existing laboratory equipment and workflow know-how, so the firm can readily learn from use and improve it.

Although it uses custom-production capabilities, an orthopedic shoe last is more distant from the firm's dental and hearing core, so absorptive capacity is weaker and early market learning is less likely to justify continued commitment.

A post-curing unit is a natural complement to the firm's digital manufacturing systems and certified process expertise, giving it strong scope to assimilate feedback and strengthen the integrated offering.
